summary: Add opt-in Fractal web development scenario replay over the real SDK and live data layer, preserving the URL-selected world across navigation and replay folder transports across HMR. No production or deployment upgrade impact.

replay.detail: Scenario replay is opt-in development tooling only; no replay or rebuild of deployed runtime state is required.

schema.detail: No database, claim, or persisted browser-state schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or fleet coordination change.

compatibility.detail: No production protocol, harness, or CLI change. Replay code and scenario worlds are excluded from production builds; live startup remains the default.

downtime.detail: No deployed service change or interruption.

manual.detail: No installation, deployment, or operator action required.

recovery.detail: No production recovery or rollback behavior change.
